target.title: fix: bound gateway model pricing cache
target.body:
Closes #101543.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where long-running gateway processes could keep growing the model-pricing cache when refreshes see many dynamic provider/plugin model rows, eventually increasing heap pressure and risking OOM.

## Why This Change Was Made

The cache is capped at the shared gateway pricing state boundary so every refresh replacement path is bounded consistently. Lookup hits refresh `Map` insertion order, including normalized-model fallback hits, so refreshes prefer retaining recently used pricing rows while trimming oldest entries past the cap.

This follows the cleaner #101714 approach and avoids the separate timestamp side-map used by #101713, which would add another cache-like structure to prune.

## User Impact

Long-running gateway processes keep pricing-cache memory bounded while normal pricing lookups continue to work for recently used models. Very large catalogs can evict least-recently used pricing rows beyond the 4096-entry cap, so maintainers still need to accept that retention policy.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: the shared gateway pricing state boundary caps replacement payloads at 4096 entries, evicts oldest rows, preserves direct lookup hits, and preserves normalized lookup hits across an over-limit refresh.
- Current branch head: `b16e5b6646e01ee98f471201c9021fc7a464fe3d`.
- Source path checked: `refreshGatewayModelPricingCache` calls `replaceGatewayModelPricingCache` for both seeded-only and full refresh maps, so the state-boundary cap covers the real refresh replacement path.
- Direct terminal proof of the bounded state behavior:

```text
[direct-cap] size=4096
[direct-cap] model-0 evicted=true
[direct-cap] model-1 evicted=true
[direct-cap] model-2 retained={"input":2,"output":3,"cacheRead":0,"cacheWrite":0}
[normalized-lru] lookup before refresh={"input":42,"output":43,"cacheRead":0,"cacheWrite":0}
[normalized-lru] size=4096
[normalized-lru] lookup after refresh={"input":42,"output":43,"cacheRead":0,"cacheWrite":0}
[normalized-lru] model-0 evicted=true
[normalized-lru] model-1 evicted=true
[normalized-lru] newest retained={"input":4096,"output":4097,"cacheRead":0,"cacheWrite":0}
```

- Focused regression coverage added in `src/gateway/model-pricing-cache.test.ts`:
  - over-limit replacement caps size and evicts oldest rows
  - recently used direct lookup rows survive an over-limit refresh
  - normalized lookup hits also refresh recency and survive an over-limit refresh
- Intended focused check for CI / clean checkout: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/gateway/model-pricing-cache.test.ts`

Proof gap: I could not run the focused Vitest locally in this sandbox because the available local checkout is a sparse, dirty unrelated branch without `node_modules`, and Git fetch timed out. The PR includes the focused regression tests so CI can run the canonical repo validation.
